node.title: (OUT-m) as an aggregate identity, and its (DEG-m) corollary
node.closure: a constraint on the configuration space, refined to an exact double count
node.statement: At a minimising pair union with (SAT1)-(SAT4), T = rho+2 and a = 7m-1, writing X'_gamma = |S_gamma ^ (S_g D S_h)| and X''_gamma = |S_gamma ^ (S_g ^ S_h)|, one has X'_gamma + 2 X''_gamma >= m-1-eps_gamma with eps_gamma the total saturation deficiency on S_gamma. The original aggregate rider sum eps <= 1+O is FALSE -- a deficient point outside W charges every type-2 block through it, so the correct aggregate is (m-1)(1+O) -- and the corollary that X_gamma = 0 is impossible requires 1+O < m-1, i.e. O <= m-3, which is vacuous at m = 2. The refinement of record is the exact identity sum_gamma eps~_gamma = sum_x def(x)*t_x with t_x the number of type-2 blocks through x, charging m-1, m-2 and m-3 per unit of deficiency at outside, symmetric-difference and middle points respectively; it is a trivial double count once stated, the aggregate (m-1)(1+O) is attained only by outside deficiency, the m=3 witness attains it exactly with sum = 2 while the refuted rider gives 1, and the m=2 exhibit charges 0. The corollary (DEG-m): in sigma-designs X' = 2 deg_H, so deg_H(gamma) + X''_gamma >= ceil((m-1-eps~)/2) subject to the exact middle budget sum_gamma X''_gamma = (m-1)(m-2); hence at m >= 4 a degree-1 slope requires middle support, which round 34's DFS never imposed. (DEG-m) has zero selection power (tightened and relaxed 2-sharing ceilings are bit-identical at 7/12, two fields) but is decisive at completion, where n_1 = 9 against a completeness bound of 4 upgrades the 2-sharing m=4 negative from a ceiling to dead-objects-at-the-ceiling.
